VIJERON / COLOR DESK

Method, sources and limits

WCAG contrast formulas, color variation method, material origin and the correction process for Measured Color.

Contrast checker

The tool uses WCAG 2.2 relative luminance and ratio for two solid sRGB colors. AA decisions use the full ratio before display rounding. It does not determine actual rendered text size or audit a whole interface.

Color variations

Five variants use sRGB channel arithmetic toward black and white. Results are not paint mixtures, predictions for every display or aesthetic harmony claims. Ratios against black and white help review each candidate.

Editorial and corrections

Text, examples and visuals were made for Vijeron on 10 October 2026. W3C links support concepts, not an affiliation. Send corrections with the page URL through the portal contact page.
